description: This course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to manage the modern hybrid multi-cloud IT infrastructure as the backbone of the systems and processes that supports a company’s business strategy, technological innovation ability, and digital capabilities. Students will also learn the key components and needs of the modern cloud infrastructure so as to be able to design, deploy and manage cloud services and enterprise solutions on it.

title: Cloud Services and Infrastructure Management
